summary: The WhatsApp APK is the Android installer for WhatsApp Messenger, Meta's free app for encrypted chats, voice and video calls, groups and Status updates. Google Play updated it on November 21, 2026 with shared group history for new members and better group calls. It's free to download, with no subscription.
metaDescription: WhatsApp APK download for Android: get the latest official WhatsApp from Google Play or whatsapp.com, with install steps, new features and safety tips.

faq.q: How do I download the WhatsApp APK for Android?
faq.a: Install WhatsApp from Google Play, published by WhatsApp LLC. If your phone has no Play Store, WhatsApp offers its own official APK at whatsapp.com/android, signed with the same key as the Play version. Avoid APK files from any other site.

Yes. Personal messages and calls are end-to-end encrypted by default, so only you and the person you're talking to can read or hear them. Turn on two-step verification in Settings → Account to stop someone else registering your number.

WhatsApp's minimum age is 13 in most countries (16 in some). It has no parental controls of its own, so set Privacy → Groups to My contacts and keep profile photo and last seen to My contacts for younger users.

faq.q: Why is WhatsApp not working on my phone?
faq.a: The most common causes are no internet connection, an outdated app, a wrong date and time on the phone, or WhatsApp's servers having an outage. Update the app from Google Play, switch between Wi-Fi and mobile data, and restart your phone.

faq.q: Can I use WhatsApp on my laptop?
faq.a: Yes. Open web.whatsapp.com or the WhatsApp desktop app for Windows or Mac, then scan the QR code from your phone in Settings → Linked devices. You can link up to four devices to one account.
